title: A Sunny Day in Hillside Town

concept.title: A Sunny Day in Hillside Town
concept.logline: On sunlit, epic Viborough, you wander far to recover the brass keys and restore the Campanile.
concept.source_prompt: Hillside Town. town hillside village terraced exploration Grand tour
concept.player_fantasy: You are a wanderer who arrives at Hilltop Piazza and becomes the one who brings the Campanile back to life.

characters.name: Odo the Trader
characters.description: Trades gossip about Viborough for anything shiny.

characters.description: A harmless street cat that bolts if you come too close.

nodes.speaker: Mayor Bram
nodes.text: So you've come to Hilltop Piazza at last. I am Mayor Bram. On sunlit, epic Viborough, you wander far to recover the brass keys and restore the Campanile.

choices.text: What do you need from me?

nodes.speaker: Mayor Bram
nodes.text: Back again. Hilltop Piazza is quieter while you're out there.

nodes.speaker: Mayor Bram
nodes.text: Go to Market Stalls, then Olive Terraces. Whatever still remembers A Sunny Day in Hillside Town is out there. Bring it back to me.

nodes.speaker: Mayor Bram
nodes.text: Before anyone lived in Hilltop Piazza, A Sunny Day in Hillside Town was kept by people who wrote nothing down. Warm, even then.

nodes.speaker: Mayor Bram
nodes.text: Market Stalls: Market Stalls: a camp on the way out from Hilltop Piazza.

nodes.speaker: Mayor Bram
nodes.text: You found something out there. I can see it on you. That's one piece of A Sunny Day in Hillside Town back where it belongs.

nodes.speaker: Mayor Bram
nodes.text: Olive Terraces: Olive Terraces: a grove on the way out from Hilltop Piazza.

nodes.speaker: Rook the Courier
nodes.text: Rook the Courier circles your feet, then looks toward Campanile as if it already knows the way.

nodes.speaker: Rook the Courier
nodes.text: Rook the Courier sniffs the air. Something about Campanile has it restless.

nodes.speaker: Rook the Courier
nodes.text: It turns toward Campanile. Campanile: the far end of the classic hub and trail, where the story ends.

nodes.speaker: Odo the Trader
nodes.text: Welcome to my corner of Hilltop Piazza. Odo the Trader's wares have come a long way to get here.

nodes.speaker: Odo the Trader
nodes.text: Rope, oil, dried fruit, and maps of A Sunny Day in Hillside Town that are only a little wrong. Nothing you can't find for yourself, if you're patient.

nodes.speaker: Odo the Trader
nodes.text: People say lights move at Market Stalls after dark. I don't go there myself.

nodes.speaker: Street Cat
nodes.text: The street cat freezes, watches you with one bright eye, and looks ready to bolt.
